title: Choose GitGraph's visual world
question: One direction will govern repository selection, architecture exploration, and risk intelligence. Choose it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Engineering Field Station
options.thesis: A calm operational console where every signal earns its place.
options.viewport: A stable three-zone workspace: repository context, living architecture map, and focused evidence.
options.risk: Can feel familiar if the graph does not remain the clear centre of gravity.

raised.raise: Keyboard-first command access and visible operational feedback.
Dense data remains disciplined through a strong positional grid, never decorative noise.

options.label: The Codebase Atlas
options.lineage: technical cartography and architectural drafting tables
options.thesis: The repository becomes a map that engineers can read, search, and annotate under pressure.
options.viewport: Architecture fills the working field while navigation and diagnostics sit in measured margins.
options.risk: The map metaphor requires careful density management on smaller screens.

options.label: Phosphor Command Line
options.lineage: green-phosphor terminals in midnight machine rooms
options.thesis: A keyboard-led workspace where exploration reads like a precise system transcript.
options.viewport: A command rail frames the live repository graph and a searchable analysis transcript.
options.case: Strong audience identification, but it risks reducing visual relationships to text-first interaction.
options.risk: Can privilege nostalgia over spatial comprehension.

options.label: Data Field
options.thesis: Information density becomes a crisp, kinetic field.
options.viewport: A wide evidence field makes repository scale feel physical.
options.case: Too abstract for daily code exploration.
options.kept: Its courage to make dense data structurally quiet rather than card-heavy.
options.risk: Accessibility and sustained reading become harder at full commitment.

options.label: Pixel Metropolis
options.thesis: The codebase is a discoverable city of modules.
options.viewport: Modules become city blocks in a zoomable graph.
options.case: Memorable but too metaphorical for evidence-heavy engineering work.
options.kept: Its clear zoom-level transitions for moving between overview and detail.
options.risk: Novelty competes with the product's analytical purpose.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.viewport: A clean dark application shell with a repository tree, graph canvas, and inspector.
canonCard.risk: Clear and safe, but less distinctive from the tools engineers already use.
